title: Phanaʼ language
description: Loloish language spoken in China and Laos
extract: Phanaʼ ; also called Bana or Pana) is a Loloish language of Laos and China. Phanaʼ is spoken by 500 people in Laos. In China, it is spoken in Mengla County, Yunnan Province.
